messages.text: Hello, i wanted to see what is currently in stock that would be available to ship with my upcoming order please
Happy to. Let me pull live stock now.
Searched the catalog · miner
Searched the catalog · hotspot weather station antenna

Here's what's shipping now, 2 to 5 business days: Hammer Miner BC04, 6 TH/s, $239. Hammer Miner DC02, 105 MH/s Scrypt, $239.99. NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s, $359.99. BSB NerdQaxe++ 6 TH/s, $249. On the DePIN side, Wingbits WB200 at $475 and the WXM WS2000 weather station at $400.

Stock on a few of those is region-specific. What country are you shipping to, and do you already have an order open?
USA

Correction for the US, sorry: the NerdOctaxe and the NerdQaxe++ are both out of stock in US plugs right now, only UK stock left.

Shipping now to the US: Hammer Miner BC04, 6 TH/s, $239. Hammer Miner DC02 Scrypt, $239.99. NerdQX, 8 TH/s, $299.99. Wingbits WB200 at $475. WXM WS2000 weather station at $400. Helium Mobile indoor hotspot at $200.

Bitcoin or Dogecoin side, which are you leaning toward?
btc

Two that actually ship now. NerdQX, 8 TH/s at ~145W, $299.99, four BM1370 chips and an LCD. Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s at ~100W, $239, wifi and ethernet.

The NerdQX gives you more hash per dollar. The B.04 is the cheaper call if your power is expensive, it runs a third less wattage for a quarter less hash.

Want me to put one in a cart?
thank you for the info
Anytime. Both are there when you're ready, and I can build the cart in a second. Just shout if you want the checkout link.
at this point i am hoping to add more th/s items

Straight answer: nothing bigger than 8 TH/s ships right away in US plugs. You'd either stack NerdQX units, or wait a bit for real hashrate.

If you can wait, the GekkoScience KBOX is 22 TH/s at 330W for $800, roughly 19-day lead. Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 5, ships November 14. Harlo B30 is 30 TH/s at $899, (address hidden), November 30.

The K. gets you there soonest. What's your budget and power situation?
i currently have 2 BSB on order with y'all, does the Magic Miner only solo pool?

The listing only describes solo, pointed at your own node and address, for the full block reward. It doesn't say anything about pool config either way, so I won't guess. Let me confirm with the team whether it'll accept a pool.

On the two BSB units, I can check where they are. What's the order number and the email on it?
awesome let me get the order #'s
Sounds good. Send the order number and the email on the order, and I'll pull it up.
looks like the chat and order feature has changed
No login needed here, just the number off your confirmation email. It looks like #···· or Shop····, either works. Send that plus the email address the order went to and I'll look it up.
how do i find my order #'s now

Search your inbox for "HeliumDeploy". The order confirmation email has it in the subject line, something like "Order #···· confirmed". Shipping notifications carry it too.

If nothing turns up, email (email hidden) from the address you ordered with and a person will dig it out for you.

I do need the number plus the email to pull an order, I can't match on email alone.
Got it, ····. What's the email address on that order?
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Ran escalate.py (store-orders skill)

Found it. Shop····, placed August 21, paid, nothing shipped yet. One Harlo B30 (the BSB B30, renamed) plus a Power Kit, $897.73, heading to (address hidden).

No batch date shows on the order my side, so I won't quote one. I tried flagging it to a person and that failed, so email (email hidden) with the order number and this address for the confirmed date.

Also, only one B30 on this order. Do you have a second order number?
and ····
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

That's Shop····, placed July 20, paid, also unshipped. Same pair, a B30 and a Power Kit, $840.47.

So both B30s have been sitting since July and August. I'm sorry, that's too long. Three choices and it's your call: wait for the confirmed batch date, swap either order to something shipping now, which I can do right here, or cancel for a full refund.

The date question still needs a person, so email (email hidden) on that.
i still want both units and yes it has been a very long wait time
Ran escalate.py (store-orders skill)

Understood, both B30s stay as they are.

I tried again to put this in front of a person and it won't go through from my side, so do this: email (email hidden) with both numbers, Shop···· and Shop····, and the address on them. Ask for the confirmed batch date on each. Two orders that old get looked at by a manager.

Anything else I can pull up while you're here?
i was hoping because i have done a good amount of business with Helium that they would be here sooner

I hear you, and you're right that two orders sitting since July isn't how this should go. I can't promise a date or a credit, that's genuinely not mine to give, but it belongs in the note to support along with the order numbers.

One thing I can do today: swap one of the two to a miner that actually ships this week, and keep the other B30 in the queue. That way something's running while you wait. Want me to price that out?
i think i need to hit support, b/c the BSb30's are really what i was wanting, i really liked the hash rate compared to the cost of running

Fair enough, and honestly that's the right call if the B30 is the machine you want. Nothing else in the lineup matches 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 watts for $899.

Email (email hidden) with Shop···· and Shop···· and the email on them, and ask for the confirmed batch date on each. Orders that old don't sit with first line, they go to a manager.

Sorry it's been this long. I hope they land soon.
hey maybe they will throw me a discount code or a free miner lol

Ha, I'd love to be the one handing those out, but I can't promise a code or a unit, and I'd rather not set you up for a letdown. Worth asking support though, they have room I don't when an order's been waiting this long.

Put the wait in the email plainly, both order numbers, dates you placed them. That's the part that gets attention.
